title: UGREEN CM648 25052USB-C to RJ45 2.5G Ethernet Adapter

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The UGREEN CM648 (25052) USB-C to RJ45 2.5G Ethernet Adapter is a high-performance networking solution designed to provide ultra-fast and stable wired internet connectivity for modern devices. With support for 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet (2.5Gbps), it delivers significantly faster speeds compared to standard Gigabit adapters.


This adapter features a USB Type-C interface, making it compatible with laptops, ultrabooks, tablets, and smartphones that lack an Ethernet port. It supports plug-and-play functionality, allowing easy installation without additional drivers on most operating systems.


Built with advanced chipset technology, the CM648 ensures low latency, stable connection, and efficient data transmission, making it ideal for gaming, streaming, large file transfers, and enterprise networking. Its compact and durable design makes it perfect for both office and travel use.


Key Features


  • USB-C to RJ45 2.5G Ethernet adapter
  • Supports up to 2.5Gbps high-speed network
  • Backward compatible with 1Gbps / 100Mbps networks
  • Plug & play installation
  • Stable and low-latency wired connection
  • Compact and portable design
  • Wide compatibility with Windows, macOS, Linux
